theme: Light theme preferred (Dark mode optional toggle). High contrast, functional, minimal UI benchmarked against Linear, Notion, and Stripe Dashboard.

rules: Monochrome-first: 95% of the UI should be monochrome (white, grays, black/obsidian).
Color is Function Only: Use color (blue, red, green) strictly to guide action, indicate status, or highlight active states.
No full-screen gradients. Texture over gloss.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Flat Solid' surfaces. Dashboard cards should have a flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), and no shadow by default. On hover for clickable cards, apply a slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and subtle shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism. It creates visual noise in data-heavy enterprise tools. Use solid backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for tables and dense lists. Use 1px borders (border-collapse, border-slate-200) to separate data.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react. Use uniform stroke widths (1.5px or 2px). Do not use AI emojis.

components.buttons: Unified buttons: 4px border-radius (rounded). High contrast. Primary buttons: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50. Tertiary/Ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900.
components.forms: Unified form controls: 4px border-radius, clean 1px border. Focus states must have a 2px offset ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400 focus:outline-none). Remove explanation-driven UI (helper text) unless critical. Labels should be text-sm font-medium.
components.tables: Unified tables: dense layout. th: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-left text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 py-2 px-3 border-b border-slate-200. td: text-sm text-slate-900 py-2 px-3 border-b border-slate-100.
components.cards: Ruthlessly remove dead space. Padding should be p-4 or p-6 maximum. Remove decorative labels. Cards are strictly for grouping related operational data.
components.header: Simplified canonical header. Solid background (bg-white), 1px bottom border (border-slate-200). Sticky positioning (z-50). Include Breadcrumbs for 'Where am I?' (e.g., Home / Operations / Daily Report).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense and compact spacing (p-2, p-4, p-6). Ruthlessly remove dead space, but maintain optical balance. Tailwind scale overrides: use gap-4 or gap-6 for most bento grids.
grids_and_layouts.layout_mode: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density Grid). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or a 12-column grid for complex dashboards.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Unified sidebar or top canonical header. Every page must immediately reveal: Where am I? What requires my attention? What should I do next?

motion.transitions: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback only. Use transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out for buttons/links/rows.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the layout exact dimensions. No bouncy or playful spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA minimum. Text on surfaces must be high contrast (slate-900 on white, slate-500 for secondary).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-1 focus:ring-slate-400.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-current='page' for active navigation, aria-hidden='true' for decorative icons.

images_and_media.rules: Enterprise software uses minimal photography. Use avatars for users if necessary. No generic decorative stock photos.

3d_libraries.recommendation: None. This is a high-density operational OS. 3D will add unnecessary cognitive load. Use Recharts for 2D data visualization.

instructions_to_main_agent: Mission: Build an Enterprise Operating System, not a component library.
Consistency before creativity: Use the exact same button styles, input fields, tables, and typographic hierarchy across Admin, HR, Safety, Transportation, etc.
Eliminate visual noise: Remove helper text, duplicate navigation, repeated actions, and decorative elements.
Use lucide-react strictly for functional indicators.
Ruthlessly remove dead space: maximize data density while keeping it readable.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts or heavily customize Shadcn UI components in .js/.jsx format to match the exact unified aesthetic.
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure every page immediately reveals: Where am I? What requires my attention? What should I do next?
DO NOT use a transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Apply micro-interactions on hover and focus states.
Use solid backgrounds over glassmorphism for this specific enterprise app.
DO NOT center align the app container. Left-align dense content.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, etc.) for icons. Always use icon libraries.
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='submit-report-button').
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
